commitments.title: Record how to continue the work
commitments.wire: A steward leaving a commitment behind leaves instructions a successor can follow.

commitments.title: Keep a runnable check for every live commitment
commitments.wire: A maintained commitment can be exercised; the check that proves it still runs.

commitments.title: State the commitment's real condition
commitments.wire: Record condition as it is, including decay, so the next decision starts from truth.

commitments.title: Track obligations you have accepted
commitments.wire: An accepted obligation is recorded with its state so it cannot silently lapse.

commitments.title: Answer commitments made to people
commitments.wire: Relationships to past work include the people who rely on it; respond inside the stated window.

commitments.title: Notice what your work depends on and what depends on it
commitments.wire: Stewardship looks both directions: upstream drift and downstream reliance are both watched.

commitments.title: Triage decay before it compounds
commitments.wire: Scheduled attention to aging work keeps small rot from becoming abandonment.

commitments.title: Retire commitments in the record, not in silence
commitments.wire: A ended commitment is marked ended, with its final state recorded where successors look.

commitments.title: Leave notes for the future self who inherits the work
commitments.wire: The steward's own return is a relationship to past work; record context the returning self needs.

commitments.title: Keep recorded data usable for the next reader
commitments.wire: Data under stewardship stays findable, described, and loadable, or its limits are stated.

commitments.title: Re-examine a maintained thing before others rely on it again
commitments.wire: Prior correctness does not survive drift; re-run, re-read, and re-decide before reuse.

commitments.title: Declare how often each commitment is visited
commitments.wire: A stated visit cadence makes neglect observable instead of invisible.
